Container.Name: counter-strike-wasm
Container.Overview: Counter-Strike 1.6 (GoldSource) in the browser via Xash3D-FWGS + CS16 client compiled to WebAssembly. Main menu is a single Join Game screen that connects to the hosted match over a WebRTC bridge. Requires your own Half-Life + Counter-Strike data files mounted at /data.
Container.Requires: You must supply your own legally-owned Half-Life and Counter-Strike game data. Place valve-owner.pk3, valve-liblist.gam, cstrike-owner.pk3 and cstrike-liblist.gam under the Game Data path in a goldsource/ subfolder. Multiplayer additionally needs the WebRTC bridge + listen-server host companion (see goldsource-wasm/engine/artifacts/runtime).

Config.Name: Game Data
Config.Description: Container Path: /data — holds goldsource/ with the owner .pk3 archives
